name: Enclav
tagline: Enterprise-grade governance for the communities you steward.
positioning: Enclav unifies dues, reserves, and architectural review into one system of record for the nation's largest community association managers.

hero.h1: The system of record for the communities you manage.
hero.sub: Enclav consolidates assessments, reserve studies, violation workflows, and architectural review into one auditable platform built for portfolios of thousands of associations.

features.title: Assessment & delinquency engine
features.description: Automate dues billing, late fees, and lien-eligible escalation with a full ledger trail your auditors and boards can trust.

features.title: Reserve study intelligence
features.description: Model funding scenarios against component life cycles and generate board-ready reserve reports without a spreadsheet in sight.

features.title: Violation & compliance tracking
features.description: Capture inspections in the field, route notices on your governing-document timelines, and maintain a defensible record per unit.

features.title: Architectural review portal
features.description: Give homeowners a guided submission flow and give committees a queue with SLA timers, quorum tracking, and decision logs.

features.title: Board & meeting governance
features.description: Assemble agendas, packets, and minutes with e-signature, then archive every motion against the community's bylaws.

features.title: Portfolio analytics
features.description: Roll up cash position, delinquency, and open violations across every association in your book of business in real time.

testimonials.quote: We migrated 41,000 doors onto Enclav in a single quarter. Delinquency reporting that used to take our accounting team ten days now closes in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Marianne Delacroix

testimonials.quote: The architectural review module alone eliminated our biggest source of homeowner disputes. Every decision is timestamped, sourced to the CC&Rs, and defensible.
testimonials.name: Gregory Nakamura

testimonials.quote: Our boards finally trust the numbers. Enclav's reserve modeling gave us a level of financial governance our directors expect from an enterprise vendor.
testimonials.name: Patrice Okafor

pricing.blurb: For growing management firms standardizing operations across their book.
Volume usage tiers for firms operating at regional and national scale.
For national managers with compliance, data residency, and SLA needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Enclav is the enterprise system of record for community association management, trusted by firms overseeing more than a million doors.
